title: FetchURLParams
description: Fetch one http:// or https:// URL from the machine running nocx. The request is direct, never through a terminal pane's remote host, and returns bounded UTF-8 text windows from one run-scoped snapshot.

url.description: The complete web URL to fetch; repeat the original URL for a continuation.

start.description: First byte of the decoded UTF-8 text to return. Omit for the first window; continue at the previous window's end.

revision.description: Opaque run-scoped snapshot revision from an earlier result. Required for continuation windows.

result.title: FetchURLResult
result.description: One bounded byte window from the complete decoded UTF-8 response captured under revision. JSON responses are indented and HTML responses are reduced to readable text before this window is made. The result keeps the original authorized URL identity, and a continuation repeats that URL and revision with start set to window.end; an expired revision is refused rather than re-fetched.

total.description: Total bytes in the complete decoded UTF-8 text.

revision.description: Opaque revision identifying the run-scoped snapshot.

start.description: First decoded UTF-8 byte returned, inclusive.

end.description: One past the last decoded UTF-8 byte returned; always a UTF-8 boundary.

returned.description: Decoded UTF-8 bytes represented by text in this window.

truncated.description: True when bytes remain after this window.

dropped.description: Decoded UTF-8 bytes omitted after this window because of the result bound.

remaining.description: Decoded UTF-8 bytes still omitted after this window.

lossy.description: Whether charset decoding substituted replacement characters or HTML presentation extraction changed the response.
